title: Atelier Helix TOP100 (live GitHub GraphQL, 2026-08-21)
rule: Live-verified stars/licenses. Archived Flowise/TensorZero/openai-forward dropped. Patterns only, no vendoring.

projects.why: Fair-code workflow automation with 400+ integrations and native AI agent nodes; the glue layer of self-hosted AI stacks.
projects.integrate_as: Automation spoke: publish finished assets to CMS/socials/storage via n8n webhooks from loom.

projects.why: The standard for running LLMs locally with an OpenAI-compatible server; one-line model pulls.

projects.why: The historic Stable Diffusion web UI with a huge extension ecosystem; development has slowed but the API and extensions remain widely deployed.

projects.why: Production platform for agentic workflows: visual pipeline builder, RAG, model-agnostic BYOK, observability built in.

projects.license: Open WebUI License (BSD-3 derived + branding clause)

projects.why: The standard JavaScript 3D library; renderer for every GLB/GLTF asset on the web.
